 Terengganu vs DPMM FC Brunei Prediction: DPMM Strike as Terengganu Rebuild Up Front
 Start 20/11/2026 13:00 00 Days 01 Hour 50 Minutes 05 Seconds Malaysia Super League Terengganu vs Dpmm Fc Brunei 20.11.2026 
 Anastasia Dudkina 19/11/2026 16:36 Statistics of the month: 162 142 3 52.77 % ROI:   -0.09 % Statistics Odds Bet Type Bookmaker Claim Bonus! Odds 2,26 Bet Type Team Total Goals: Away Over 1.5 Bookmaker Bonus 100 € Bet now! Terengganu vs DPMM FC Brunei: Prediction for the match on November 20, 2026
 Terengganu will welcome DPMM FC Brunei at the Sultan Mizan Zainal Abidin Stadium. As of 1 November, Terengganu are sitting in 9th place in the Malaysia Super League with 5 points. With the team near the bottom of the table, the management released a statement about a warning letter to the coaching staff before this game. DPMM FC Brunei on the other hand are in 4th place with 12 points and can move higher in the standings. However, they can not qualify for AFC competitions through the league. 
 Receive Your Welcome Bonus! Terengganu: Form and statistics
 Terengganu suffered a 2-0 loss away at Sabah in their last match. They were already two goals down at half-time. Terengganu had six shots in the game while Sabah had seven. Despite chasing the game, they managed only two shots on target.
 Before the loss to Sabah, Terengganu lost 3-0 at home to Johor Darul Ta’zim and 3-1 at home to DPMM in the FA Cup. They had drawn 1-1 away at Star City after winning 3-2 away at DPMM in the first leg of the cup. That win was their last before going six games without a win. Nafuzi Zain has his international players back without injuries, but will have to check for fatigue after their long journey. 
 Terengganu: Lineup
 Terengganu will be without Gervane Kastaneer after he picked up three yellow cards, while Romel Morales is out after getting a red card against Sabah. They are expected to play in a 3-4-2-1, with Jordan Mintah leading the line and Víctor Ruiz in support, but their starting XI is not yet confirmed.
 If Nafuzi goes with the expected setup, it could be harder for Terengganu to make their forward passes stick and find runners in behind. If those passes are cut out, Murray and Dalberto can break quickly, which could keep Terengganu's wing-backs deeper and leave Mintah with less support. 
 Expected XI: Mateusinho, Shahrul Nizam Ros Hasni, Jordan Mintah, Mohd Suhaimi bin Husin, Pape Abdoulaye Diakité, Víctor Ruiz, Azam Azmi Murad, Ubaidullah Shamsul, Safwan Mazlan, G. Pavithran, H. Kutty
 DPMM FC Brunei: Form and statistics
 DPMM went out of the FA Cup after losing 6-1 away to Johor Darul Ta’zim in their last match. They were only 1-0 down at half-time. DPMM had three shots in the game while Johor Darul Ta’zim had 46, so they rarely looked like a threat. After the second-half collapse, Jamie McAllister has urged his players to stay organised in the final 20 to 30 minutes.
 DPMM return to league play, where their best Super League finish was third in 2005–06. In their last league game, they won 3-1 at home against Negeri Sembilan after losing 2-0 at home to Johor Darul Ta’zim in the first leg of the cup. Before that, they had won 3-2 at home against Kuching City and 1-0 away at Kuala Lumpur City in the FA Cup. 
 DPMM FC Brunei: Lineup
 DPMM have no reported absences for this match and are expected to stick with the 4-4-2 and the same strike partnership from their last confirmed line-up.
 With DPMM's strike partnership intact, the first pass after a turnover could go to one striker, with the other running beyond him into the box. 
 Expected XI: Haimie Abdullah Nyaring, Muhammad Toha, Ebenezer Abban, Clark Robertson, Tommy Mawat Bada, Farris Izdiham Kechik, Nicholas Swirad, Muhammad Azwan bin Ali Rahman, Miguel Ângelo Agostinho Oliveira, Jordan Murray, Dalberto Luan Belo
 Terengganu vs DPMM FC Brunei: Head-to-head statistics
 Terengganu have won three of their last four meetings against DPMM. They won both league games, beating DPMM 5-0 away and 1-0 at home. Terengganu also won the first leg of their FA Cup tie 3-2 away, while DPMM won the return leg 3-1 at Terengganu.

 DPMM have gone unbeaten in three of their last five matches, while Terengganu have failed to win four of their last five matches. The first leg is worth keeping in mind, but DPMM to win or draw is priced at 1.6 odds on 1xBet. 
 DPMM have conceded fewer than two goals in only two of their last five matches, but Terengganu have scored fewer than two goals in four of their last five matches. Betway offers 1.78 odds for Terengganu to score fewer than two goals. 
 Three of Terengganu's last five matches finished with three or more goals. Paripesa offers 1.67 odds for at least three goals. 
 Terengganu vs DPMM FC Brunei match prediction, November 20, 2026
 Terengganu's win in the first leg is the biggest warning here, but DPMM have overturned a deficit at this ground. Looking at the line-ups, DPMM should do well on the break and limit Terengganu's shots. Terengganu have conceded 11 goals in their last five matches, so I think DPMM will score three goals without reply here. Our correct score prediction: Terengganu 0-3 DPMM FC Brunei.
 DPMM have scored at least twice in only two of their last five matches, but Terengganu have conceded at least twice in four of their last five matches, so I think DPMM will score at least twice here. Our boldest prediction is Terengganu not to score here. A side has failed to score in only two of each club’s last five matches, and the cup return goes against this prediction. Nevertheless, Terengganu have scored only once in their last three matches, so I think they’ll go scoreless here. I think DPMM will win here. Terengganu have lost three of their last five matches, while DPMM have won three of their last five matches. Both of DPMM’s defeats in that run came against Johor Darul Ta’zim, so I don’t read too much into their cup exit.
